eufy L60 SES (T2277) replacement parts.

Replacement parts for the eufy L60 SES (T2277), also called L60 with Self-Empty Station. This guide covers the standard L60 robot and its self-empty dock, with separate fit notes for the filter, station bag and brushes.

Check the variant: Check the model label on the robot: this page covers L60 SES / T2277. The standard L60 (T2267), L60 Hybrid (T2268) and L60 Hybrid SES (T2278) have similar names, but the roller and some other parts differ.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

L60 SES vs. standard L60 roller
The L60 SES (T2277) uses eufy roller T29E61A1. The standard L60 (T2267) uses a different roller, T29G2111. Check the model sticker and roller end fittings; a shared filter or side brush does not mean the rollers are interchangeable.
Filter and side brush
eufy's accessory listings include both L60 and L60 SES for the washable filter T29C7121 and side brush T29D11A1. These shared fits do not extend to the main roller or station bags.
L60 SES vs. L60 Hybrid SES
The Hybrid SES is T2278 and adds a mopping module. eufy lists its T29E61A1 roller for both SES versions, but the linked Amazon roller listing names L60 SES and not L60 Hybrid SES. Check each Amazon listing for the exact variant before ordering.
Robot filter vs. station bag
The washable filter sits in the robot's dust box. A disposable dust bag sits inside the Self-Empty Station. The standard L60 without that station does not use a dock bag.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

eufy L60 SES (T2277) maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s original-model manual gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

eufy L60 SES (T2277) cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Robot dust boxAfter each useNo interval listed
Filter (eufy original)Weekly; air-dry completelyEvery 3 months
Side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months or when visibly worn
Brush guardMonthly or when visibly wornEvery 3–6 months or when visibly worn
Rolling brushWeeklyEvery 6–12 months

The manual's schedule is a starting point; hair, dust, carpets and cleaning frequency can change wear. Its washable-filter instructions apply to eufy's original filter, not automatically to third-party replacements. The station bag is disposable; replace it when full or when the station indicates it needs attention.

Before you order

How do I tell an eufy L60 SES from an L60 Hybrid SES?

Check the model label: L60 SES is T2277, while L60 Hybrid SES is T2278 and has a mopping module. This page is for T2277. Some official parts are shared, but verify each listing rather than relying on the L60 name alone.

Does the L60 SES use the same roller as the standard L60?

No. eufy lists roller T29E61A1 for L60 SES and T29G2111 for standard L60. The Amazon listing above explicitly includes L60 SES, but compare its end fittings with your T2277 roller before ordering.

Can I wash the replacement filter in this guide?

The linked COWINORY filter is a third-party product; its Amazon listing advises replacing it every 1–2 months and does not establish that it is washable. eufy's original filter T29C7121 is washable. Follow the care directions for the exact filter you buy.

Are these genuine eufy replacement parts?

The four Amazon replacement-part listings here are third-party products, not eufy OEM parts. eufy's corresponding original part numbers are T29C7121 (filter), T29E61A1 (SES roller), T29D11A1 (side brush) and T29C6121 (station dust bags).
